quotes.text: Right now, most companies cannot tell you their carbon footprint. Not because they don't want to or don't care, but because the data is a complete mess.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Names the real root cause behind poor carbon reporting.

quotes.text: The platform has three main jobs, record your emissions, report on them accurately, and reduce your impact over time. Record, report, reduce. That's the cycle.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Summarises the platform's purpose in a memorable three-step cycle.

quotes.text: Think of an emissions factor as a conversion rate. For every mile in a certain type of vehicle, a fixed amount of CO2 is produced.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains emissions factors with a simple, concrete analogy.

quotes.text: The real value isn't just checking compliance boxes, it's about finding ways to save money while shrinking your environmental footprint.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Reframes sustainability reporting as a business opportunity.

quotes.text: If you're a business leader or handling ESG data, start by figuring out where your sustainability data lives today. That's the single most powerful step you can take.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Gives a clear, actionable first step for listeners.

takeaways: Most companies cannot state their carbon footprint because sustainability data is scattered across systems, formats and units.
Microsoft Cloud for Sustainability brings data in via Excel templates, Power Query, partner connectors or manual requests and applies built-in emissions factors across scopes 1, 2 and 3.
Ready-made templates for frameworks such as CSRD, an auditable data trail and AI-drafted disclosures turn months of manual reporting into a far faster process.
hook: Asked to report your company's carbon footprint but buried in utility bills, spreadsheets and supplier data? This episode explains to business leaders and ESG teams how Microsoft Cloud for Sustainability collects that data, calculates emissions with built-in factors and produces reports for frameworks like CSRD.
